criteria.statement: Config contains a fips section with disabled-by-default ingestion, relay URLs, app namespace default fips-overlay-v1, auto-register default false, allowed npubs, and overlay prefix default fd00.
Worker domain records can represent a FIPS overlay IPv6 address and advertised udp/tcp/tor transport endpoints.
DNS domain constants and validation accept mesh endpoint family and mesh zone visibility.

The FIPS subscriber subscribes to Kind 37195 with a d-tag scoped to fips-overlay-v1, handles EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH paths, validates events, parses OverlayAdvert content, matches workers by pubkey, and applies derived fd00::/8 overlay state through the worker repository.
